scheme_name: Financial Assistance Scheme For Higher Competitive/ Entrance Examination To Scheduled Castes/ Backward Classes Students
other_conditions: The candidate must possess all requisite qualifications required for the examination.
The candidate cannot avail more than two chances for a particular competitive examination.
The candidate must attend all classes; if absent for more than 5 days at a time or a total of 15 days without valid reason, the coaching benefit will be discontinued.
Beneficial coaching can be availed by a candidate up to two times irrespective of the number of attempts for a particular exam.
The scheme applies only to courses not covered by any other scheme for Scheduled Castes and Backward Classes.
benefits_summary: Free postal or classroom coaching for IAS, other civil services and related competitive examinations, including pre‑entrance and interview preparation, provided to SC/Backward Class candidates.
